map.由事件概率求其补事件概率: Probability of the Complement from an Event Probability
map.输入事件概率 p，求对立事件概率。: Enter the event probability p to get the probability of the complementary event.
map.📖 查看「由事件概率求其补事件概率使用指南」: 📖 View the "Probability of the Complement from an Event Probability User Guide"
map.对立（补）事件概率等于 1 减去原事件概率，两者之和恒为 1。用于「至少发生一次: The probability of the complementary event equals 1 minus the event probability, and the two always add to 1. It gives a quick route to problems such as at least one occurrence or none occurring: when computing an event directly is cumbersome, take the complement instead.
map.所有可能事件概率之和为 1。: The probabilities of all possible events sum to 1.
map.\"至少一次\"用 1−全不发生 更简。: "At least once" is simpler as 1 minus none occurring.
map.单次成功 p=0.3：至少一次（三次）=1−0.7³=1−0.343=0.657: With single-trial success p=0.3, at least one success in three trials is 1−0.7³=1−0.343=0.657, simpler than adding up the separate terms.
map.当正面计算项数多（如\"至少 1\"=\"1 或 2 或…或 n\"）时，补集\: When a direct calculation has many terms (such as at least 1 meaning 1 or 2 or ... or n), the complement none occurring usually settles it in a single term.
map.互斥才成立？: Does it require mutually exclusive events?
map.补集公式对任意事件均成立，不要求互斥；互斥是另一概念（加法定理）。: No. The complement formula holds for any event and does not require mutual exclusivity, which belongs to the addition rule.
